item.title: Episode 47 - The Bear God
item.itunes:title: Episode 47 - The Bear God
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang continues to be separated as Greaek and Sherwood make their way through the underground lair of the Willow Peaks, while Brenna and Akio must deal with having their objective without a full party. Will the group ever reunite? Will the be the same once they do? Find out now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening. You can write us on Twitter @SneakPodcast, or email us at sneakattackpodcast@gmail.com. Leave us a review on iTunes as well, we really appreciate that! Also, stop by https://battlebards.com if you would like more info about our music and effects we use.

item.title: Episode 48 - White Water
item.itunes:title: Episode 48 - White Water
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang goes through dire circumstances in order to free and reunite themselves. Sherwood and Greaek must face the tribunal, while Brenna and Akio have to figure out how to recover from losing their horses. Will they ever complete their objectives and return to fighting as a team? Find out now!

item.title: Episode 50 - On the Trail
item.itunes:title: Episode 50 - On the Trail
item.description:
On this brand new episode of Sneak Attack!, Sherwood and Greaek regroup after barely escaping the mysterious dwelling of the fish people who live under the Willow Peaks. Meanwhile, Brenna and Akio leave Gianni's house with their newly acquired horses and make their way to Brightcove in an effort to track down Arlan's powerful crystal. Will they find the gem before it is too late, and will Greaek and Sherwood ever make up their lost ground? Find out now!

 

A HUGE thank you to everyone who has made fifty episodes of Sneak Attack! possible. I am overwhelmed with love from our listeners, and truly appreciate it. You make all of us want to do this show every week. You can drop us a line on Twitter @SneakPodcast, or email us at sneakattackpodcast@gmail.com. Shout out to https://battlebards.com for letting us use their sound effects and music for our show!

item.title: Episode 52 - Fly Away Home
item.itunes:title: Episode 52 - Fly Away Home
item.description:
On this weeks episode of Sneak Attack!, the sky-bound duo fights for their life against two Gryffin-riding warriors of Arlan Brampton. They are desperately trying to get to Brightcove to meet up with Brenna and Akio before they need to scuttle Arlan's plans to send a portal crystal off-island. Will they be able to complete the heist in time? Will Greaek and Sherwood find them before it's too late? Find out now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening! Write us on Twitter @SneakPodcast, or email us at sneakattackpodcast@gmail.com. You can also leave us a review on iTunes or whatever podcast service you use. It really helps! Thanks to our friends at https://battlebards.com for letting us use their sound effects.

item.itunes:title: Episode 66 - The Temple, Part 6
item.description:
On this week's episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang moves through the second floor of the temple, eager to discover its secrets, and find the missing half of the spell scroll. After defeating the three monsters of the arena, and leaving the library, they are tasked with solving a strange puzzle involving levers and statues. Would they be able to solve the riddle, or would the spell scroll be forever out of reach? Find out now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening! Drop us a line on Twitter @SneakPodcast, or shoot us an email at sneakattackpodcast@gmail.com. Also, you can leave us a podcast review on iTunes, or the service of your choosing! Huge thanks to our friends at https://battlebards.com for letting us use their amazing sound library.

item.title: Episode 67 - The Temple, Part 7
item.itunes:title: Episode 67 - The Temple, Part 7
item.description:
On this week's episode of Sneak Attack!, after completing the statue puzzle and moving to the third floor, the gang confronts the ghastly spirit that had been haunting them all throughout the third floor of the pyramid temple. Tensions run high and spell slots run low as the gang faces off against their more dangerous opponent yet. Would this foe prove too challenging, or would the gang prevail once more? Find out right now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening! We really hope you enjoy the episode, and if you do feel free to drop us a line on Twitter @SneakPodcast, or you can email us at sneakattackpodcast@gmail.com. We also absolutely love iTunes reviews! Special thanks to our friends at https://battlebards.com for the use of their sounds effects!

item.title: Episode 68 - The Temple, Part 8
item.itunes:title: Episode 68 - The Temple, Part 8
item.description:
On this week's episode of Sneak Attack!, the gang continues their way through the Temple of Melius the Enraged, seeking out the powerful 9th Level Spell Scroll. The group has just defeated Delphina, the spectral wife of Melius, but not without both Greaek and Akio falling to her powerful magic. Greaek was revived by Sherwood, but what would the fate of Akio be? Find out right now!

 

Thanks everyone for listening. If you like the episode, hit us up on Twitter @SneakPodcast, or shoot us an email at sneakattackpodcast@gmail.com. Also, you can leave us an iTunes review! We really appreciate any and all love for the show. Special thanks to our friends at https://battlebards.com for letting us use their music and sound effects!
